pattern_name: Obligation & advice: have to / must / should
pattern_name_ar: الإلزام والنصيحة: have to / must / should
formula: have to / must + base (necessity) · don't have to (no obligation) · should + base (advice)
when_to_use: Use have to / must for necessity, don't have to for no obligation, and should for advice.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم have to / must للضرورة، و don't have to لغياب الإلزام، و should للنصيحة.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners add 'to' after must/should ('I must to go'), and confuse 'mustn't' (prohibited) with 'don't have to' (optional).

common_errors.explanation: No obligation = don't have to; mustn't = prohibited.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: We ___ (not have to) pay for children.

quick_rule: Necessity → have to / must. No obligation → don't have to. Prohibited → mustn't. Advice → should.
quick_rule_ar: ضرورة → have to / must. لا إلزام → don't have to. ممنوع → mustn't. نصيحة → should.
mnemonic: SHOULD = advice · MUST/HAVE TO = necessary · MUSTN'T = forbidden.
connect_to_speaking: Give rules and advice: 'At work I have to arrive early, but I don't have to wear a suit. You should get more sleep.'
